description: Golden QA set for the NAP chat (no LLM), aligned with the live production corpus (5 news, 4 events, 8 faqs, 3 scholarships, 3 stories, 6 courses, …). Every fixture runs through the exact retrieve -> build_answer pipeline used by /api/chat. `topic` is the intent-taxonomy target for classify_topics (Phase 1+); `titles` are expected quoted source titles; `contains` are substrings the answer must include. Fixtures whose phrasing the current KB cannot answer yet are kept deliberately so Phase 1-3 improvements become measurable.
